text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, while {0} is out taking a stroll...
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}が散歩をしている時だった……

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight?
text_block_list.text: You there! Stop walking at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこのキミ、
止まりなさい！

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight?
text_block_list.text: You seem... suspicious. Yes, very suspicious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミ……怪しいね？　
ものすごく怪しいぞ。

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight?
text_block_list.text:
The punishment for suspiciousness is death!
If you want to live...
text_block_list.orig_text:
罰として死刑にする！
それが嫌なら──

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight?
text_block_list.text:
Hand over lots of pudding!
Pudding or death!
Quick, gimme pudding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プリンを出せなの～！
さもないと、死刑なの～
早くプリンを出すの～！

text_block_list.name: Royal Knight?
text_block_list.text: H-how did you know Miyako was possessing this armor?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんで取り憑いてるってわかったの！？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... M-Miyako's plan was a big fail this time...
Just this once, I give up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～、
ば、
バレたら仕方ないの～
今回は諦めるの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: Sad face...
text_block_list.orig_text: スーーー………………

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day, while {0} is out shopping...
text_block_list.orig_text:
翌日──
{0}が買い物をした直後──

text_block_list.name: Monster?
text_block_list.text: Graaaaarghhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Passerby 1
text_block_list.text:
Aaahhhh!
It's a monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃー！
魔物よ！？

text_block_list.name: Passerby 2
text_block_list.text:
It went that way!
Watch out, kid! It's headed for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっちに行ったぞ！
そこの君、危ないっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster?
text_block_list.text:
Rooooar! I'mma eat you all up!
If you want to be not food, gimme pudding instead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐおー、
お前を食ってやるのー！
嫌ならプリンをよこせなの～！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I thought that monster costume was a super good idea...
How did you see through Miyako's clever trick?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……魔物の着ぐるみなら、
騙せると思ったのに……
なんでわかったの～？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Now I remember...
You have a super strong sixth sense!
That's how you always tell when Miyako is hiding?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
そういえば{0}は、
レイカンっていうのが、強いやつだったの！
そのせいで、
正体がミヤコだってわかったの！？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: ...M-Miyako is defeated again!

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh... Miyako's pudding-stealing plans all end up failing...
But, but, Miyako still needs tasty pudding!
...Only one option left. Time for my final special plan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～～
プリンを奪い取る作戦、失敗なの～……
でも、
やっぱりプリン食べたいの～
……こうなったら、
最後の手段なの！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
This time, I'll possess... YOU!
Vazwoom! In I go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}に取り憑いてやるの～
えいっ、なの～！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay! Possessing is successing!
Now I can do anything with {0}'s body!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ～い、成功なの～！
これで{0}の体を自由に動かせるの～！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
I can buy puddings with {0}'s money!
All the puddings money can buy!
It'll be a pudding festival!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}のお金で、プリン買っちゃうの～
買えるだけ買っちゃうの～！
プリンフェスティバルなの～♪

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Pudding shop person!
Bring every pudding on the menu!
I have moneys! So gimme pudding! All the pudding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プリン屋さ～ん！
メニューの端から端まで持ってこいなの～♪
金ならあるの～！　
どんどん持ってこーい！　
なの～♪

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ummmm...?
What's this {0} was carrying?
Looks like a shopping bag... What could be inside?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん？
{0}、なにか持ってるの？
お店の袋……何が入ってるの～？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Pudding inside! Yaaay! 
Now there's no need to even buy any! So lucky 
for Miyako that {0} happened to have pudding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、プリンなの～！
わーい、
買ってくる必要なかったの～
{0}が偶然持ってて、もうけたの～　
むふ～♪

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm?
Wait. Why would {0} have pudding?
One, two puddings... And two spoons too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
でも、なんで{0}はプリン持ってたの？
プリン二つに、
スプーンも二つなの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! I remember...
{0} said he would play with Miyako later...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　そういえば、
このあと{0}と遊ぶ約束してたの……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text: Can it be... he brought pudding for Miyako?
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………もしかして、
ミヤコの分なの？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh...
Time to cancel Miyako's possessing plan...
choice_data_list: Wh-where am I?! Who am I?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
む～
取り憑くの、やめるの～

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Your name is {0}. No forgetting obvious things!
How many fingers is Miyako holding up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
オマエは{0}なの～
　
しっかりしろなの～！
この指は何本に見えるの？

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Can't see them through Miyako's sleeves?
Well done! Correct answer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……服で隠れて見えない？
よしよし、
正常なの～♪

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's all wrong!
Miyako doesn't talk like that!
Miyako is much more charming and cuteful! Hmph!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
ちがうの～！
ミヤコはオマエなんかより、
もっともっとチャーミングなの～！　
ぶーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Miyako is sorry for possessing you...
Hey, {0}... That pudding...
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝手に取り憑いて悪かったの～
{0}、
そのプリン……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
Did you really buy it just for Miyako?
Yaaaay! Pudding for Miyako!
Let's eat pudding together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりミヤコのために買ってくれたの？
わ～い、
プリンなの～
一緒に食べるの～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} and Miyako ate the pudding together
with huge smiles on their faces.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と仲良くプリンを食べて、
大満足のミヤコであった。
